column7: local-lane; orchestration layer only - no LLM is called unless CREW_BASE_URL is set, so a crew cannot silently spend. Repo Python 3.14 cannot build crewai (numpy metadata fails), which is why it lives in its own 3.11 venv. Tools wrap the existing pure modules (render_bind, aplus_layout, asset_handoff, brand_memory); the Flow stays the orchestrator.
